title: This, Here, and In a Place
label: ch:pa-pointing-place-a1
canDo: I can point to this or that, ask where a familiar thing is, and answer that it is here, there, or in a familiar place.

payoff.summary: Ask where a familiar book or shop is, then answer with here, there, or a familiar place plus vich and hai.
payoff.note: This closes five named points in a partial project-defined A1 inventory. It is a gentle curriculum exchange, not an A1 mock, readiness decision, attainment claim, or human validation.
